observations: Source page 4 is kept: three lines and the caption match word for word, and as the source requires, no diagnosis or treatment is shown.

On the composed page, 04-1 establishes the consultation room without a caption: Ananya at a desk with a closed laptop, a window and plant, and Ravi in the patient chair with his bag on the floor. 'Hello, Ravi' confirms it is the doctor meeting him.

The first reading's 'no response to tired lately' is a deliberate source constraint. 04-3 shows Ananya leaning in and nodding (motion marks), and 04-4's 'your concerns' refers back to his tiredness without medical advice.

Screen direction stays consistent: Ananya left, Ravi right in 04-1. 04-2 has Ravi facing left with the back of Ananya's head at the left edge; 04-3 has Ananya facing right with the back of Ravi's head at the right edge; 04-4 is a two-shot.
The clipped labels and the caption over the face box are storyboard artefacts. On the real page the 04-3 caption covers only the top of Ananya's hair, and her eyes and expression stay readable.
Unnumbered scan: one text element per panel. The order runs top, middle-left, middle-right, bottom, with nothing nearby to jump to.

Composed page used: Ravi's hand on his neck and open mouth in 04-2 lead into Ananya's silent listening face under the narration box in 04-3. The caption reads as narration over her reaction, not as her speech.
The 04-1 and 04-4 balloons sit between the two characters with short tails to Ananya's mouth, and Ravi is clearly listening in both.

transitions.observation: From reception, where Meera points to the chairs, to the consultation room with Ravi now seated, in the same shirt and with his bag set down. It reads as later in the same visit.
From the two-shot in to Ravi, with the back of Ananya's head at the left, answering 'what brings you in'.
A reverse to Ananya listening with folded hands, with Ravi's back at the right edge. The axis stays the same and the closed laptop is still on her desk.
Back to the 04-1 two-shot with the same desk, chairs and bag. She speaks with an open hand and Ravi nods (motion marks).
Ravi's bag goes from the floor back to his shoulder, and the scene moves from the consultation room to the reception monitor and waiting chairs with Meera. It reads as after the consultation.
